description: NaYSi₂O₆ is Esseneite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.90 Å. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.58 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted YO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one YO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.38 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-67°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one YO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.71 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-67°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Y and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Y, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Y, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂YSi trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Y, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂YSi tetrahedra.
